closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, works across a lot of cooking styles, and easy comfort-food base with less baggage than junk food, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low vitamin A, and low protein quality. It is good for practical meals, energy and endurance sports, and low-calorie volume because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, the carb section gives usable fuel, and it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure.
